correctness.rationale: The outermost coefficients in the exact fourth-order difference equation are lambda^2/T^2 and (1-lambda)^2/T^2; nonzero for 0<lambda<1, yielding a global companion diffeomorphism with constant determinant ((1-lambda)/lambda)^2. At lambda=1/2, z_(k+1)=z_(k-1), and the displayed explicit inverse to the four-state parity chart proves a global smooth conjugacy of the second iterate to invariant constants plus two shears, each area preserving. Arbitrary alternating scalar sequences and their converse classify all prime two-cycles. The exact two-step tangent block has determinant one, trace 2+4*T^2*Lprime(u)*Lprime(v); two fixed-index directions provide the remaining unit multipliers. Area preservation excludes asymptotically attracting periodic points. Source in RESULT.md; exact rational and passive numerical checks in CHECKER.py and CHECKER_OUTPUT.txt supplement the analytic proof.
